Face to face.
p.everywhere.sub: Talk to someone who doesn't speak your language.

p.everywhere.c_err: We can't read your contacts right now.

p.everywhere.out_ea_on: Adam 1 hears what Adam 2 says in his headphones. Adam 2 reads their translation up.

p.everywhere.hands_pause: Hands-free system in call (no sound). Click on microphone to continue.
p.everywhere.set_out_ea_d: You wear headphones bought in the store, already connected to your phone via Bluetooth, you hear the translation of what the other person says; they read theirs on the screen.
